# x-profile-analyzer

> AI-powered X/Twitter user profile analyzer. Give a username; no X API key and no login needed. Fetches up to ~300 public tweets via Nitter + Camofox and generates a 10-dimension persona report with MiniMax or any OpenAI-compatible LLM. (X/推特用户画像分析工具，无需 API Key。)

Key points:
- No X/Twitter API key or login required; public tweets only.
- Scraping: Nitter pages opened through Camofox (localhost:9377), cursor pagination, up to ~300 tweets per account.
- LLM backends: MiniMax, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OPENAI_API_KEY / OPENAI_BASE_URL / OPENAI_MODEL).
- `--no-analyze` data mode: export structured tweets for your own AI agent.
- 10 report dimensions: topics, writing style, engagement habits, tech focus, deep motivation, behavior prediction, zodiac guess (for fun), how to approach them, one-line sketch (all LLM), plus a weekday activity heatmap (computed locally).
- Python 3.7+, no third-party dependencies, MIT license.

## Responsible use

Reports are AI inferences from public tweets. Do not use for harassment, stalking, doxxing or discrimination.
